name: Terah
overview: Terah, also called Thara or Thara in the Greek text, is identified in Scripture as the father of Abram (later Abraham), Nahor, and Haran, establishing his key role in the patriarchal lineage (Genesis 11:24-27). He lived in Ur of the Chaldees, where his son Haran died before him (Genesis 11:28). While the verses highlight Terah as the progenitor of Abraham, they also imply his association with idolatry, marking a contrast between his faith and the calling of his son Abram.
